ja.seo_title: Vepdegestrantの休薬・再開PK | Daiki Kumakura
ja.summary: 公開ヒトPopPKモデルで休薬・再開後のAUC、ピーク、投与前濃度を比較。2,048組の条件付き計算と、蓄積倍率の不一致から予測の範囲を考える。

en.title: Vepdegestrant exposure after interruption and restart
en.summary: A public vepdegestrant model compares restart exposure with uninterrupted dosing while retaining unresolved accumulation and covariance-definition uncertainty.

english.title: Vepdegestrant interruption and restart: conditional PK
english.summary: A public oral PK model explores omitted doses and restart with matched prior histories. Accumulation mismatch and covariance ambiguity limit clinical extrapolation.
